title: Drunk Mom Nearly Kills Her Child After Crashing Into Pole
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On October 24th, 2022. Officers responded to the scene of an accident in which a HIGHLY intoxicated mum crashed her car head-on into a light pole with a minor in the car. When officers arrived on the scene, the woman could barely stand due to her level of intoxication. The paramedics said they found her daughter outside of the car on the floor with minor abrasions on her head, she had to be taken to the hospital. When the officers tried to question the woman, she just kept saying her daughter wasn't safe with her father. Multiple witnesses gave their statements and put her to driving the vehicle. Officers found that she had been taking prescription drugs before even getting behind the wheel while also consuming alcohol. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
